exposure: sequential combination of povidone-iodine with alcohol and chlorhexidine with alcohol skin preparation
cohort: Women undergoing nonemergent cesarean birth at greater than 37 0/7 weeks of gestation.
finding: The three skin preparation techniques (povidone-iodine with alcohol, chlorhexidine with alcohol, or sequential combination of both) resulted in similar rates of surgical site infections after cesarean delivery.
